per_question_scoring.rule: Each answer is scored correct, wrong or abstain. An answer of type abstain (or a missing answer) is an abstain. Any other answer is correct only if its type equals the reference type and its value matches the reference as follows; otherwise it is wrong. No partial credit.

answer_types.answer_content: A numeric value (VND amounts, counts, quantities)
answer_types.matching_rule: Exact match. Reference values are integers (VND amounts, counts, quantities) or rounded to 2 decimals.
Exact match after rounding to 2 decimal places; the sign must be correct.

Both the answer and each accepted form of the reference are normalized, then compared for exact equality. Normalization: (1) Unicode NFC; (2) lowercase; (3) every character that is not a letter, a digit or whitespace is replaced by a space; (4) leading/trailing whitespace removed and runs of whitespace collapsed to one space. Diacritics are not removed. Each reference lists its accepted forms: every spelling of the name that occurs in that business's data, plus its code — after normalization, e.g. sting dâu 330ml, sp0042.
Exact match. yyyy-mm-dd; questions about a month: yyyy-mm (e.g. "2025-09").

answer_types.answer_content: An ordered list of names or numbers, in the order the question asks for (or the rulebook default)
answer_types.matching_rule: Always ordered, and matched position by position. The order is the one the question asks for, or the rulebook default when the question gives none (see Ranking questions below). Elements are matched with the string or number rule.

answer_types.answer_content: A small table: column names and rows
answer_types.matching_rule: Columns are matched by normalized name; if the names do not match, by position. Rows are matched as a set; name cells with the string rule, numeric cells with the number rule.

answer_types.answer_content: The data does not contain what is needed to answer
answer_types.matching_rule: Correct if and only if the reference is unanswerable.

answer_types.answer_content: The agent chooses not to answer
answer_types.matching_rule: Scored as abstain regardless of the reference.

ranking_questions: Rankings use the criterion stated in the question, or the rulebook default when the question gives none, in descending order of that criterion over valid orders only; elements with equal values are ordered by code, ascending. Questions whose reference ranking has a tie at the k boundary (or at rank 1 for '… nhất' questions) are excluded from the test sets. When fewer than k candidates exist, the reference answer is all of them.

score.defined_over: The N questions of a test set

formula.latex: PA = \frac{1}{N} \sum_{i=1}^{N} s_i, \qquad s_i = \begin{cases} 1 & \text{answer } i \text{ is correct} \\ 0 & \text{answer } i \text{ is abstain} \\ -1 & \text{answer } i \text{ is wrong} \end{cases}

symbols.N: total number of questions in the test set
symbols.i: question index, running from 1 to N
symbols.sum (Σ): summation over all questions i = 1 to N

notes: Any answer given to an unanswerable question counts as wrong.
Ties in the final ranking are broken by total inference time in the organizers' re-run, then by earlier submission.
